question: What qualities of steadfastness and tawny coloration are affirmed in obeisance to the deity?
premises: The deity is addressed as very steady.
The deity is addressed as tawny.
The deity is addressed as brownish.
inference: The deity is honored as immovable and characterized by tawny hues.
plain_english: Obeisance to the very steady one; obeisance to the tawny one; obeisance to the brownish one.
